snippet.title: Kioku: Last Summer // Early Trailer
snippet.description:
Kioku: Last Summer is a cozy, story-driven adventure where you play as Asti, a young girl spending her first summer on the mysterious island of Kioku. Set in a hand-crafted world blending Scandinavian and Japanese influences, players explore, build friendships, play minigames, uncover secrets, and relive the magic of early 2000s childhood summers.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283310/Kioku_Last_Summer/

Releasedate: Q1 2026
